//: Copy to dream-tts.json. Every key is optional; unknown keys are an error, so a typo cannot silently do nothing. `dream-tts config` shows what resolved and from where.
//quant: f16 is already the default for qwen3tts, and is the only format that batches. q8_0 saves 0.58 GB and costs 62% of the speed; see the README.
//data_dir: Where checkpoints and fixtures live. Relative to this file's directory; absolute to put 13 GB on another disk. Default: alongside the install.
//gpu_lock: One engine on the GPU at a time. Two resident engines do not fit in 16 GB and the machine swaps rather than failing. Turn this off only if you know better.
